name: Sawaca Enterprises Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Sawaca Business Machines Ltd is engaged in sale of various chemical products and scrap material.
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1]
a) Scrap Trading: Company sources and supplies premium grade metal scrap with different grades of Copper 
scrap, Aluminum Scrap, SS scrap, SS pata patti, etc. 
b) Cotton bales: Shankar-6 variety Cotton Bales to local traders and also directly to textile mills all over India.
c) Aromatic Chemicals: Mixture of Aromatic Chemicals, Base Industrial Perfumery Compounds and Essential Oil.
d) Export: Company exports Machinery and various Raw materials to East African countries. Company buys machinery from suppliers across India and then exports it. At present, company is exporting Machinery for Biscuit Manufacturing plant, Mineral Water plant and machinery required for packaging. It also supplies Raw material required for Biscuit Manufacturing Plants.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.38 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -9.95% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -6.28%
Working capital days have increased from 37.2 days to 154 days
